properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The engine's ONLY signature algorithm: ECDSA over NIST P-521 (secp521r1, the sole supported curve — __openssl_get_ec_nid, openssl_suite.c:82-88). Signs identity chains, node ephemeral keypairs and transport packets (TRANSPORT_MAC_TYPE_EC_P521, transport_packet.c:228/288/328), and verifies remote identity during the transport handshake — i.e. it authenticates the same key exchange that ECDH secures, so a forged-signature future retroactively impersonates endpoints. Changeable here; provider is ve

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Digest-registry entries (DIGEST_ID_SHA384/DIGEST_ID_SHA512). SHA-512 is the workhorse digest of this library: the HKDF digest for protocol v4 message key exchange and the transport handshake/root-key derivation (KDF_HKDF_SHA512 at protocol.c:53, transport_handshake.c:350, transport_root_key.c:97), and the HMAC digest for stream IV generation (stream_iv.c:81, DIGEST_SHA_512). 512-bit output already meets CNSA 2.0. Changeable here.
